name: btc-dao meeting minute
description: Draft minute for a btc-dao meeting: one section per agenda item (docs/drafts/meeting-protocol.md section 3), then the status block (section 7.1). Schema and transcript placement to be confirmed at the MT-0 dry run.

sections.title: 0 Opening
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 0 Opening in two to four sentences. Covers: Date, chair, and members present (in the room and remote) by the names they gave.

sections.title: 1 Record
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 1 Record in two to four sentences. Covers: Is the DAO's site, relay and record working? Any unauthorised spends?

sections.title: 2 Members
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 2 Members in two to four sentences. Covers: Members vouched in or leaving, badges earned, who still needs help trying a part of the DAO.

sections.title: 3 Proposals and treasury
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 3 Proposals and treasury in two to four sentences. Covers: Drafts read aloud, open votes, results, payout rounds signed at the table.

sections.title: 4 Council and keys
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 4 Council and keys in two to four sentences. Covers: Council health, spare key, recovery sheets confirmed, council change. This is a due item: if the check was not done, the status is overdue.

sections.title: 5 Operate
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 5 Operate in two to four sentences. Covers: Operators and credentials, Agent tasks, inbound mail and replies. If the chair read it in the 'Not yet' line, the status is not yet.

sections.title: 6 Trade
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 6 Trade in two to four sentences. Covers: Payment requests, statement, throughput. If the chair read it in the 'Not yet' line, the status is not yet.

sections.title: 7 Mainnet
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 7 Mainnet in two to four sentences. Covers: On testnet: what stands between the DAO and mainnet. On mainnet: is the treasury structure still sound.

sections.title: 8 Lineage
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 8 Lineage in two to four sentences. Covers: Child DAOs, mentoring, forks proposed or completed.

sections.title: 9 Rules
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 9 Rules in two to four sentences. Covers: Charter, settings, funding model, and whether the agenda itself is still right.

sections.title: 10 Close
sections.instruction: Use only what was said in the transcript. Never invent decisions, names, amounts or links. If nobody spoke to this item, write exactly: No business. Write in the language the meeting mostly used.
sections.prompt: Summarise agenda item 10 Close in two to four sentences. Covers: Next meeting date. Anything left for the next meeting.

sections.title: Status block
sections.instruction: Output only the block below, as plain text, with no other words. Replace <status> with exactly one of: business, no business, not yet, overdue. Keep the numbers and keys unchanged.
sections.prompt:
MINUTE <DAO name> <YYYY-MM-DD>
0 opening: <status>
1 record: <status>
2 members: <status>
3 proposals-treasury: <status>
4 council-keys: <status>
5 operate: <status>
6 trade: <status>
7 mainnet: <status>
8 lineage: <status>
9 rules: <status>
10 close: <status>
